label: Telemetry (Unified)
description: Sends live match/player/pickup telemetry to a local relay for stats-hub ingestion. Low-priority frame hook — designed not to cost sv_fps. Requires the telemetry-relay sidecar service running on the host; not something QLSM installs by itself yet.

cvars.label: Enabled
cvars.description: Master switch for all telemetry sent by this plugin.

cvars.label: Position Telemetry
cvars.description: Sends live player position/view-angle telemetry for the stream overlay. Falls back to the legacy qlx_streamTelemetryEnabled cvar when unset.

cvars.label: Pickup Telemetry
cvars.description: Sends item-pickup events. Falls back to the legacy qlx_pickupTelemetryEnabled cvar when unset.

cvars.label: Pickup Telemetry Debug
cvars.description: Logs extra debug output for pickup telemetry.

cvars.label: Session Events
cvars.description: Sends player join/leave session events. Falls back to the legacy qlx_sessionEventsEnabled cvar when unset.

cvars.label: Stats Hub URL
cvars.description: Ingest URL telemetry is POSTed to (either the stats-hub directly, or the local telemetry-relay).

cvars.label: Stats Hub Token
cvars.description: Auth token sent with each telemetry POST. Direct mode (qlx_statsHubUrl points at stats-hub): must be stats-hub's STATS_HUB_INGEST_TOKEN from its .env on the stats-hub host - NOT STATS_HUB_API_TOKEN (the dashboard/read token); the wrong one is a silent HTTP 401 that trips this plugin's circuit breaker. Relay mode (qlx_statsHubUrl points at a local telemetry-relay): use that relay's own "token" from telemetry-relay.json instead.

cvars.label: Send Interval (s)
cvars.description: Seconds between telemetry sends during normal play.

cvars.label: Idle Interval (s)
cvars.description: Seconds between telemetry sends when the match is idle/warmup.

cvars.label: Match ID Override
cvars.description: Fixed match ID to tag telemetry with, instead of an auto-generated one.

cvars.label: Server ID
cvars.description: Server ID this instance reports telemetry as. Must be a unique positive integer coordinated with whoever operates stats-hub - 0 (default) silently disables the whole position-telemetry feed, no error logged. In relay mode it must also match a telemetry-relay routes/ key; in direct mode it's just the id stats-hub uses to build the match_id ("server-<id>") - reusing another live server's id merges/overwrites its match.

cvars.label: Tournament ID
cvars.description: Tournament ID this instance's telemetry is tagged with.
